text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy green vegetable, wilted and glossy-dark green with pale yellow-green stem pieces, cut into irregular chunks about 2-4 cm, moist with a slight sheen, soft and limp, spread across the left half of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate surface, piled about 2-3 cm high | 150
ITEM 2 | Cooked meat pieces, brown and seared on the outside with darker char edges, cut into irregular cubes and slabs about 2-3 cm, some glazed with a sticky golden-orange coating and bits of yellow-orange seasoning, firm and slightly juicy, clustered on the right side covering roughly 15% of the plate, about 2 cm high | 130
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown glossy sauce or glaze with small crumbly orange-brown bits, pooled among and under the meat pieces, partially covering roughly 4% of the plate | 15
ITEM 4 | Corn cob cross-section rounds, two pieces, bright yellow kernel rim with pale creamy-white centre, each about 4 cm in diameter and 2.5 cm thick, firm and moist, sitting side by side on the lower right of the plate | 90
